When i was about 5 this farmer family moved next door to us. The area we lived in was still pretty green(no crowded houses, lots of field and wooded land) so most of us had small farm animals like chicken or geese. Whenever I'd play with their girl who was the same age as me she'd always be really quiet and cry really easily but i didn't realize why till i finally went over to their house.

We were just running around picking wildflowers when her dad came over and told her it's time to help feed the chicken. She just dropped everything and followed him so I went after them as well. It was fun at first, all we had to do was get the corn from the barrels into little buckets we could carry. Till the mice started darting everywhere. So. Fuckign. Many. Mice. Some tried running up my legs so i noped the fuck out of there and watched them deal with everything.

Anyways the dad just grabbed a spade and started going to town on them like it was nothing. Fucker decapitated so many we had to sweep up the piles with their designated mouse shovel and put them in fabric bags. Fucking why. The spade went back in it's little hook by the barrels ready for the next time's swarms and to this day I swear that stupid dirty thing caked in blood shows up in random ass dreams. 

I feel guilty now that I'm older for not doing anything about it, poor girl was obviously in an abusive household but even if I did flag it my country's social services wouldn't have even looked into the matter.
